channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Lawyers Have News For ICE Haters Who Think ‘Legal Observers’ Are Special
item.description: Leftist protesters calling themselves "legal observers" have no unique First Amendment rights when interacting with law enforcement, legal experts told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

item.title: Anti-ICE Protesters Harass Random Man For Crime Of Driving A Chevy Suburban
item.description: Protesters harassed a man driving a rental SUV after appearing to mistake him for an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer, a video that went viral on X Thursday shows.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: John Cornyn Unveils Legislation To Slap Penalties On Anti-ICE Agitators Following Renee Good Shooting
item.description: Senate Republicans unveiled legislation Thursday to combat a surge of attacks against federal immigration officers.

item.title: Greenlander Opposes America Taking Over His Island Because He Hunts ‘Cute’ Whales, Seals
item.description: A Greenlander interviewed by The New York Times said he opposes the U.S. gaining control of the world’s largest island because he is "afraid" it would upend his ability to hunt whales and seals.

item.title: Trump Administration Wants Coal Plants Running
item.description: The Trump administration says it intends to keep every U.S. coal plant operating, arguing that rising electricity demand and industrial growth leave no room for shutdowns.

item.title: Mamdani Appoints Woman Named ‘Afua Atta-Mensah’ As Chief Equity Officer
item.description: Democratic New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani named Afua Atta-Mensah as the city’s new Chief Equity Officer and commissioner of the Mayor’s Office of Equity & Racial Justice on Thursday.

item.title: Canadian PM Declares ‘New World Order’ In Chummy Partnership Talk With Beijing
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney declared a "new world order" during a friendly visit to China on Thursday where he also praised the "leadership of President Xi Jinping."

item.title: ALAN RECHTSCHAFFEN: Trump Trumps The Fed To Win Big
item.description: Last Friday, the Justice Department served the Federal Reserve with grand jury subpoenas related to Fed Chair Jerome Powell's congressional testimony regarding the Fed’s building renovations. Powell cried foul, claiming the real target is Fed independence and interest rates.

item.title: Noem Announces New Deputy Director Of ICE
item.description: The Trump administration has tapped a longtime Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) official to serve as second in command of the agency.

item.title: SAMUELE FURFARI: Europe’s Outrage Over Maduro Arrest Reflects Poor Understanding Of Oil Industry
item.description: The dramatic arrest of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro sent shock waves around the world. Yet nowhere was the reaction more negative – and more baffling – than in the European Union, where outrage swept through public discourse, a stark contrast to the generally positive reaction in the U.S. and elsewhere.
